attributes.name: quote markup structure
attributes.definition: Which HTML elements are used to mark up quotations on the page.

values.definition: blockquote paired with a cite element, without figure/figcaption.
Quote wrapped in figure, with blockquote and figcaption for attribution.
Short quotes marked with the inline q element.
A blockquote used alone, without cite or figure/figcaption wrapping.
No semantic quote markup or some other approach.

attributes.name: secondary text inline tags
attributes.definition: Whether semantic inline tags such as small, strong or b are used for secondary text or metadata.

values.definition: small, strong and/or b tags are used for secondary text or metadata.
Secondary text is styled without these inline tags.

attributes.name: pull quote accent rule
attributes.definition: Whether a quote is visually set off by a colored rule along its edge.

values.definition: Quote has a left border in an accent color.
Quote is set off by some other visual treatment.
